守密人你好：
    在 V2.6.1.0 版本维护更新后，「轮转之相」唤醒界面的【规则说明】中，命轮概率显示存在异常。该异常仅为文本表现问题，实际唤醒产出概率和定向规则实际与V2.6.1.0更新前一致。
    具体异常显示和实际概率如下：
● 选定的 SSR 定向命轮概率 2.38% 错误地显示为 0.00%。
● 「忘却篇」往期限定 SSR 命轮的概率 0.03% 错误地显示为 0.16%。
● 常驻 SSR 命轮概率 0.11% 错误地显示为 0.03%。
● SR 命轮概率 1.56% 错误地显示为 0.13%。
● R 命轮概率 4.37% 错误地显示为 1.56%。

    唤醒机制的公开、透明是守密人信任的基石，对于本次界面显示错误给各位守密人带来的困惑与不良体验，我们致以最诚挚的歉意！

【补给物资】
唤醒概率展示异常补偿：宿命定格·忘却篇×1

【领取条件】
领取时间截至2026年10月6日23:59。请记得及时前往邮箱领取补给物资哦。

——✦——✦—— ✦✦✦ ——✦——✦——

**Notice and Apology Regarding Abnormal Drop Rate Display in "Phases of Rotation" Awakening Rule Description**

Dear Keeper,
    Following the V2.6.1.0 maintenance update, an anomaly occurred in the Wheel of Destiny drop rate display within the [Rule Description] of the "Phases of Rotation" Awakening interface. This anomaly is solely a text display issue; the actual summoning rates and targeted rules are consistent with those before the V2.6.1.0 update.
    The specific display errors and actual drop rates are as follows:
● The rate of the selected SSR targeted Wheel of Destiny (2.38%) was erroneously displayed as 0.00%.
● The rate of past limited SSR Wheels of Destiny from the "Oblivion Chapter" (0.03%) was erroneously displayed as 0.16%.
● The rate of standard SSR Wheels of Destiny (0.11%) was erroneously displayed as 0.03%.
● The rate of SR Wheels of Destiny (1.56%) was erroneously displayed as 0.13%.
● The rate of R Wheels of Destiny (4.37%) was erroneously displayed as 1.56%.

    Open and transparent summoning mechanics are the cornerstone of Keepers' trust. We sincerely apologize for the confusion and unpleasant experience caused by this interface display error!

[Compensation]
Awakening Rate Display Anomaly Compensation: Fate's Freeze: Oblivion Chapter×1

[Claim Conditions]
The claiming time ends on October 06, 2026 at 23:59. Please remember to go to your mailbox in time to claim the supply materials.
